id: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy (2004)

facts.why: Ron's closing line is 'You stay classy, San Diego.'
Ed Harken is the station director, not a producer.
It is not a line in the Wikiquote page. A line that is in the film and suits a blackberry soda is Ron's 'I'm in a glass case of emotion!'
No source I opened has a six minute story. Ron's 'I'm kind of a big deal' would fit the lead story slot.
The note says Ron takes Veronica out on the town. No source I opened shows a steak dinner.
facts.fix: Ron's glass of scotch with a side of poetry

vibe.verdict: A newsroom rundown that looks the part, with a few made-up lines in place of the real ones.
missing: I'm in a glass case of emotion (Ron)
Wes Mantooth and the news team fight (alley)
ideas: Swap 'Goodnight, San Diego' for 'You stay classy, San Diego'
Rename 'Well, I never!' to 'Glass Case of Emotion'
Add 'Sex Panther: 60 per cent of the time, it works every time' as a side note, replacing 'Hometown pride'
Swap 'Iced tea' for a 'Panda Watch' green tea
